Igor.signal_safety_reason: even/odd gate invalid (adjacency); block-interleaved coherence uninformative (non-simultaneous halves -> nan); coincidence microsaccade detector itself uses even/odd (partly confounded). Valid test = cross-reference coherence on a multi-ref-averaged build (next step).
Igor.note: refavg3 scatter reduction is robust; its signal-safety is NOT yet establishable with a valid (simultaneous + non-atlas-shared) coherence test.
